title: Why do we multiply a and c when splitting the middle term?
body: For 2x^2 - 7x + 3 my teacher said find numbers with product 6, not 3. I do not understand where the 6 comes from.

answers.body: When a is not 1, the two brackets look like (px + q)(rx + s). Expanding gives pr x^2 + (ps + qr)x + qs. The numbers you split with are ps and qr, and their product is pqrs = (pr)(qs) = a x c. That is why it is 2 x 3 = 6.
Quick check: the pair -6 and -1 multiplies to 6 and adds to -7. Then group: 2x(x - 3) - 1(x - 3).

title: When is acceleration negative in the equations of motion?
body: In the braking bike problem I used a = +3 and got a negative distance. What decides the sign?

answers.body: Pick the direction of motion as positive. Brakes push against the motion, so the acceleration points the other way and is negative. Then v^2 = u^2 + 2as gives a positive distance.
